name: Saccharine Echo
source: Scotland, 2020. Alice is a young woman struggling through a painful breakup. Hoping to distract herself with online shopping, she buys a vintage mirror — and then whispers begin to echo through her apartment. Soon, she discovers that a mysterious figure is trapped inside the mirror, and only she can help them break free [i]by forming a deeper connection[/i].
translation: 苏格兰，2020年。爱丽丝是一位正在经历痛苦的​​分手的年轻女子。为了通过网上购物分散自己的注意力，她买了一面老式镜子——然后窃窃私语开始在她的公寓里回响。很快，她发现镜中被困了一个神秘人物，只有她才能帮助他们挣脱束缚。[i]通过建立更深层次的联系[/i]。
